Definition: Hoshea, the name of five Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hoshea is the name of five Israelites. In Deuteronomy 32:44, the text says "and Hoshea the son of Nun." The life behind the name is told on the Hoshea People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hoshea matters because God knows His people by name, and Hoshea is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
